items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I used to cut Aaron's hair in school.

ctx.x: Yes. I used to cut Aaron's hair in school. You know, I was about 11th or 12th grade, see, when they'd send the younger kids over there to get their haircuts when we took barbering in school and Aaron would -- I'd always get him and I'd cut his hair and he'd just be tickling, laughing, "Hee, hee," and I never could give him a good haircut because he would laugh all the time I was cutting his hair.
